say:1:1110602001:1.text: The Warsong Festival begins today. Alsa, how are you feeling?
say:1:1110602001:1.source_cn: 战歌节今天开始……阿尔萨，你还好吗？

say:2:1110602002:1.text: For the last time, I feel fine! But <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:2:1110602002:1.source_cn: 好吧，我再说最后一遍——我觉得我已经恢复过来了！倒是<...
say:2:1110602002:1.male: For the last time, I feel fine! But <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:2:1110602002:1.female: For the last time, I feel fine! But <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

say:3:1110602003:1.text: I'm worried that if Soren and I fail in the preliminaries, we won't be able to take you to the Mars Peak.
say:3:1110602003:1.source_cn: 我有点担心，要是我跟索恩在初赛被淘汰，就没办法带你去战...

choice_prompt:4:1110602003.text: I'm worried that if Soren and I fail in the preliminaries, we won't be able to take you to the Mars Peak.
choice_prompt:4:1110602003.source_cn: 我有点担心，要是我跟索恩在初赛被淘汰，就没办法带你去战神峰了……

say:5:1110602004:1.text: No matter what, we'll give it our all.
say:5:1110602004:1.source_cn: 即使你不说，我们也会全力以赴。
say:5:1110602004:1.male: No matter what, we'll give it our all.
say:5:1110602004:1.female: No matter what, we'll give it our all.

say:6:1110602005:1.source_cn: 我们怎么能辜负朋友的愿望呢，对吧！

say:8:1110602008:1.text: Young warriors of the Uru Clan! Your trial is about to begin. Care to address your audience?
say:8:1110602008:1.source_cn: 乌尔氏族的两位年轻勇士！比赛就要开始了，不过来跟观众们...

say:9:1110602009:1.text: I am Alsa of the Uru Clan! We thank you for your support!
say:9:1110602009:1.source_cn: 我是来自乌尔氏族的阿尔萨，请大家支持我们！

say:10:1110602010:1.text: ...And I am Soren, also of the Uru Clan.

say:11:1110602011:1.text: Listen to that crowd roar! In a few moments, I'll announce the rules of the trial.
say:11:1110602011:1.source_cn: 让我们来听听观众们的呼声！稍后我会宣布本次比赛的规则！

say:13:1110602006:1.text: You've done more than enough already, leave it to us!
say:13:1110602006:1.source_cn: 你已经出力太多……交给我们吧！
say:13:1110602006:1.male: You've done more than enough already, leave it to us!
say:13:1110602006:1.female: You've done more than enough already, leave it to us!

say:14:1110602007:1.text: Alsa and I vow to get you to Mars Peak.
say:14:1110602007:1.source_cn: 我和阿尔萨，一定会带你去战神峰的。
say:14:1110602007:1.male: Alsa and I vow to get you to Mars Peak.
say:14:1110602007:1.female: Alsa and I vow to get you to Mars Peak.

say:0:1110602101:0.text: Warriors! Remember to greet the audience and your supporters!
say:0:1110602101:0.source_cn: 勇士们，与观众和你们的支持者打打招呼吧！

say:1:1110602102:0.text: I guess I'm a little nervous.
say:1:1110602102:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我还真有点害羞呢。

say:0:1110603001:0.text: This is going to be epic!
say:0:1110603001:0.source_cn: 能有机会目睹勇士们的英姿，太好了！

say:0:1110604001:0.text: Which match will be the most tantalizing?
say:0:1110604001:0.source_cn: 最有看头的一场比赛，会是什么？

say:1:1110604002:0.text: A showdown between the former champion and runner-up?

say:1:1110605002:0.source_cn: 战神布鲁特斯一定会卫冕成功！

say:1:1110606001:1.text: Mikola's about to lay down the rules! In the prelims, we'll advance through the stages and emerge with winners from two clans.
say:1:1110606001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉开始宣布规则了！初赛将采取分组晋级的方式，决出两...

say:2:1110606002:1.text: All representatives from these clans, along with last year's champion and runner-up, will have their final showdown atop the Mars Peak!
say:2:1110606002:1.source_cn: 该氏族的所有参赛代表，连同上一届的冠亚军，将在战神峰进...

say:3:1110606003:1.text: The final showdown will unfold before the watchful gaze of the Dusk Lord and the primordial warlord! All results will be notarized and stamped with Mikola's seal.
say:3:1110606003:1.source_cn: 最终的决战，将在残阳神和初代战神意志见证下开启！结果会...

say:4:1110606004:1.text: Now that formalities are out of the way, let's begin with our first matchup: the Uru Clan vs the Motu Clan!
say:4:1110606004:1.source_cn: 规则宣布完毕！那么，即将开始的比赛是，乌尔氏族对战莫图氏族！

say:0:1110610001:0.text: Phew! That was actually easier than I imagined!
say:0:1110610001:0.source_cn: 呼！比我想象中的容易点！

say:1:1110610002:0.text: Stay sharp. Stronger opponents lie ahead.
say:1:1110610002:0.source_cn: 别自得，后面会有更强大的对手。

say:2:1110610003:0.text: I know, I know! You're only the wiser one when it comes to battles...
say:2:1110610003:0.source_cn: 知道了，知道了！你也只有在面对战斗的时候，才这么成熟……

say:3:1110610004:0.text: Let's ask Mikola who our next opponent will be.
say:3:1110610004:0.source_cn: 走了，去问问曼卡拉，下一场的对手。

say:1:1110611001:1.text: Your next worthy challenger is a mighty foe who returns to us from the Remnant Peaks!
say:1:1110611001:1.source_cn: 接下来你们要迎战的——是从遗迹群山归来的强者！

say:3:1110611002:1.text: The Remnant Peaks... Magister, could it be Shak—
say:3:1110611002:1.source_cn: 遗迹群山……主人，该不会是沙——
say:3:1110611002:1.male: The Remnant Peaks... Magister, could it be Shak—
say:3:1110611002:1.female: The Remnant Peaks... Magister, could it be Shak—

say:6:1110611003:1.text: It's been some time, my worthy rival!
say:6:1110611003:1.source_cn: 有些日子没见了，我的对手！
say:6:1110611003:1.male: It's been some time, my worthy rival!
say:6:1110611003:1.female: It's been some time, my worthy rival!

say:7:1110611004:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you appeared in my dreams last night.
say:7:1110611004:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you appeared in my dreams last night.
say:7:1110611004:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you appeared in my dreams last night.

say:8:1110611005:1.text: I dreamt that you heartily praised my skills in martial arts. Naturally, I admired your supreme magical prowess in return.
say:8:1110611005:1.source_cn: 梦中，你对我千锤百炼的武技心悦诚服。自然，我也赞赏了你...
say:8:1110611005:1.male: I dreamt that you heartily praised my skills in martial arts. Naturally, I admired your supreme magical prowess in return.
say:8:1110611005:1.female: I dreamt that you heartily praised my skills in martial arts. Naturally, I admired your supreme magical prowess in return.

say:9:1110611006:1.text: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.
say:9:1110611006:1.source_cn: 梦中我们是彼此交付后背的战友。但现在看起来，却是对手。...
say:9:1110611006:1.male: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.
say:9:1110611006:1.female: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.

choice_prompt:10:1110611006.text: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.
choice_prompt:10:1110611006.source_cn: 梦中我们是彼此交付后背的战友。但现在看起来，却是对手。命运真是弄人。
choice_prompt:10:1110611006.male: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.
choice_prompt:10:1110611006.female: I saw visions of us as comrades, guarding each other's backs fiercely. But now it seems we are pitted against one another. Fate is funny that way.

say:12:1110611007:1.text: You're randomly dreaming about him? You don't find that strange?!
say:12:1110611007:1.source_cn: 好端端的居然擅自梦到主人！你自己就不觉得有点怪吗？
say:12:1110611007:1.male: You're randomly dreaming about him? You don't find that strange?!
say:12:1110611007:1.female: You're randomly dreaming about her? You don't find that strange?!

say:13:1110611008:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I share a mutual understanding of one another that extends beyond the comprehension of tiny hamsters.
say:13:1110611008:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I share a mutual understanding of one another that extends beyond the comprehension of tiny hamsters.
say:13:1110611008:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I share a mutual understanding of one another that extends beyond the comprehension of tiny hamsters.

say:15:1110611009:1.text: Ugh, I can't stand you! Anyways, take a good look at your opponent. It isn't the Magister.
say:15:1110611009:1.source_cn: ……好好看看你的对手吧，并不是主人。
say:15:1110611009:1.male: Ugh, I can't stand you! Anyways, take a good look at your opponent. It isn't the Magister.
say:15:1110611009:1.female: Ugh, I can't stand you! Anyways, take a good look at your opponent. It isn't the Magister.

say:16:1110611013:1.text: Since these two have been endorsed by <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm curious to see what they're made of.
say:16:1110611013:1.male: Since these two have been endorsed by <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm curious to see what they're made of.
say:16:1110611013:1.female: Since these two have been endorsed by <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm curious to see what they're made of.

say:19:1110611010:1.text: Shakir, it is we of the Uru Clan whom you must face!
say:19:1110611010:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔，你真正的对手是我们乌尔氏族才对！

say:20:1110611011:1.text: Two young Mauler pups? Am I wrong to assume you only made it this far thanks to the help of <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:20:1110611011:1.source_cn: 两个年轻蛮血吗？我不愿轻率决断，但你们不会是靠<sty...
say:20:1110611011:1.male: Two young Mauler pups? Am I wrong to assume you only made it this far thanks to the help of <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:20:1110611011:1.female: Two young Mauler pups? Am I wrong to assume you only made it this far thanks to the help of <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:21:1110611012:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s aid has been invaluable, but underestimating us would be a grave mistake.
say:21:1110611012:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s aid has been invaluable, but underestimating us would be a grave mistake.
say:21:1110611012:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s aid has been invaluable, but underestimating us would be a grave mistake.

say:1:1110615001:1.text: To defeat such a formidable foe—

say:2:1110615002:0.text: Could they truly have the salt to take home the Warsong Festival crown?
say:2:1110615002:0.source_cn: 难道他们真的有机会摘取战歌节的桂冠？让我们以热烈的掌声...

say:4:1110615003:1.text: Excellent! You truly are worthy adversaries. I approve! I enjoy this kind of fight.
say:4:1110615003:1.source_cn: 好！你们称得上是我沙奎尔的强敌！我喜欢这样的战斗。

say:5:1110615004:1.text: My fighting spirit swells with pride for you young Mauler cubs. I'm already eager for another scrap...
say:5:1110615004:1.source_cn: 我的战意又燃起来了，不愧是你认可的蛮血。磨练再度召唤了我……

say:6:1110615005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
say:6:1110615005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
say:6:1110615005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!

choice_prompt:7:1110615005.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
choice_prompt:7:1110615005.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!
choice_prompt:7:1110615005.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, it'll be you and I!

say:8:1110615006:0.text: The only way I'll lose is if I forget to show up.

say:9:1110615008:1.text: Now, everyone! These next two will go toe-to-toe in what's sure to be the Sunseek Arena's most exciting match yet!
say:9:1110615008:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们！残阳武斗场最激动人心的表演赛——

say:10:1110615009:1.text: This is the last festival's champion versus the runner-up—Brutus vs. Orson!
say:10:1110615009:1.source_cn: 上一届的冠亚军！布鲁特斯对阵奥格，即将开场！

say:13:1110615011:1.text: But Brutus is about to take on Orson! We've got nothing else for the moment, so why not go and watch?
say:13:1110615011:1.source_cn: 那可是布鲁特斯大人打那个奥格的比赛诶！我们现在又没有赛...

say:14:1110615012:1.text: I didn't say I wouldn't. Can you slow down?
say:14:1110615012:1.source_cn: 没说不去。你就不能稍微慢点？

say:15:1110615013:1.text: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!
say:15:1110615013:1.source_cn: 人太多了！慢点就挤不到前排了！<style=stres...
say:15:1110615013:1.male: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!
say:15:1110615013:1.female: There are too many people! If we slow down, we won't make it to the front! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, stay close to us!

say:16:1110615014:1.text: I'm going to use my trademark move "Boulder Dash" to clear a path!
say:16:1110615014:1.source_cn: 我要使出滚团开路的绝招了！

say:17:1110615015:1.text: ...Isn't that when you just roll in a ball? Alsa, wait for us!
say:17:1110615015:1.source_cn: ……不就是团成一团滚过去，喂，阿尔萨，慢点！

say:18:1110615016:1.text: Keep up! It's about to start!
say:18:1110615016:1.source_cn: 快跟上啊！马上就开场了！

say:20:1110615007:1.text: I will take that as a yes.
say:20:1110615007:1.male: I will take that as a yes.
say:20:1110615007:1.female: I will take that as a yes.

say:1:1110619001:1.text: Incredible! Is he a warrior or a god?!
say:1:1110619001:1.source_cn: 精彩！精彩！这就是战士与战神的区别吗！

say:2:1110619002:1.text: With his back against the wall, Brutus turned sure defeat into an overwhelming victory!
say:2:1110619002:1.source_cn: 绝境的逆转变为压倒的优势！荣耀的胜利属于我们的战神，布...

say:6:1110619004:1.text: Try not to look too happy...

say:7:1110619005:1.text: Attention, please! Mikola would like to graciously announce a special addition to the contest!
say:7:1110619005:1.source_cn: 咳咳，接下来，要宣布一个本届特殊的角斗表演赛！

say:8:1110619006:1.text: That's right! One of our esteemed judges for the Warsong Festival is none other than Magister Merlin of the Lightbearer Empire!
say:8:1110619006:1.source_cn: 没错！本次战歌节的特别裁判，来自耀光的大魔法师梅林——
say:8:1110619006:1.male: That's right! One of our esteemed judges for the Warsong Festival is none other than Magister Merlin of the Lightbearer Empire!
say:8:1110619006:1.female: That's right! One of our esteemed judges for the Warsong Festival is none other than Magister Merlin of the Lightbearer Empire!

say:9:1110619007:1.text: Merlin has issued a special challenge to worthy contestants! Interested participants should come see Mikola to sign up!
say:9:1110619007:1.source_cn: 在武斗场中等待大家的挑战！有兴趣的参赛者请去休息区找曼...

say:0:1110620001:0.text: Magister, what is the fake Merlin up to?!
say:0:1110620001:0.source_cn: 主人，那个假……梅林到底想干什么？！
say:0:1110620001:0.male: Magister, what is the fake Merlin up to?!
say:0:1110620001:0.female: Magister, what is the fake Merlin up to?!

say:1:1110620002:0.text: We'll just have to find out. Let's go talk to Mikola.
say:1:1110620002:0.source_cn: 只能会会那家伙再说了。我们去找曼卡拉报名吧。
say:1:1110620002:0.male: We'll just have to find out. Let's go talk to Mikola.
say:1:1110620002:0.female: We'll just have to find out. Let's go talk to Mikola.

say:0:1110620101:0.text: Orson was eliminated, just like that!

say:1:1110620102:0.text: He was no match for Brutus!
say:1:1110620102:0.source_cn: 布鲁特斯，不愧战神之名

say:0:1110620201:0.text: Orson really flopped like a fish.
say:0:1110620201:0.source_cn: 奥格真是让我太失望了

say:1:1110620202:0.text: I called it. There's no way he could've won.

say:1:1110622001:1.text: Mage of the Uru Clan, you're here to challenge the great Merlin?
say:1:1110622001:1.source_cn: 乌尔氏族的魔法师朋友，你要挑战大魔法师梅林吗？
say:1:1110622001:1.male: Mage of the Uru Clan, you're here to challenge the great Merlin?
say:1:1110622001:1.female: Mage of the Uru Clan, you're here to challenge the great Merlin?

say:4:1110622002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is great! You'll be able to see your old teacher!
say:4:1110622002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is great! You'll be able to see your old teacher!
say:4:1110622002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this is great! You'll be able to see your old teacher!

say:5:1110622003:1.text: I've always wanted to know what Magister Merlin, our homeland's savior, truly looks like!
say:5:1110622003:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们的恩人，到底长什么样子呢？真好奇！
say:5:1110622003:1.male: I've always wanted to know what Magister Merlin, our homeland's savior, truly looks like!
say:5:1110622003:1.female: I've always wanted to know what Magister Merlin, our homeland's savior, truly looks like!

say:7:1110622004:1.text: Well, congratulations. We'll still honor our journey to Mars Peak.
say:7:1110622004:1.source_cn: 嗯，恭喜……我们还是会遵守约定，登上战神峰的。
say:7:1110622004:1.male: Well, congratulations. We'll still honor our journey to Mars Peak.
say:7:1110622004:1.female: Well, congratulations. We'll still honor our journey to Mars Peak.

say:8:1110622005:1.text: Did Mikola hear correctly? Student vs teacher?
say:8:1110622005:1.source_cn: 哦？曼卡拉听到了什么？学生对战老师吗？
say:8:1110622005:1.male: Did Mikola hear correctly? Student vs teacher?
say:8:1110622005:1.female: Did Mikola hear correctly? Student vs teacher?

say:9:1110622006:1.text: In light of this, Mikola grants you special entry! Onward to the contest!
say:9:1110622006:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉决定特批，你报名通过了！快去比赛吧！
say:9:1110622006:1.male: In light of this, Mikola grants you special entry! Onward to the contest!
say:9:1110622006:1.female: In light of this, Mikola grants you special entry! Onward to the contest!

say:1:1110626001:0.text: A victory for <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Magister Merlin, you must be swelling with pride for your pupil!

say:1:1110626001:0.female: A victory for <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Magister Merlin, you must be swelling with pride for your pupil!

say:3:1110626002:0.male: Indeed, <style="stress"><player_name></style> always was my brightest student. But he's exceeded all expectations!
say:3:1110626002:0.female: Indeed, <style="stress"><player_name></style> always was my brightest student. But she's exceeded all expectations!

choice_prompt:4:1110626002.source_cn: 咳、其实，<style=stress><player_name></style>一直是我最看好的学生。果然没有辜负我的栽培！

say:5:1110626003:0.source_cn: 我的孩子，这里不是说话的地方。
say:5:1110626003:0.male: My dear boy, this is not the place to chat.
say:5:1110626003:0.female: My dear girl, this is not the place to chat.

say:6:1110626004:0.text: We must have a proper catch-up in a more appropriate... private, place.
say:6:1110626004:0.source_cn: 我们很快会继续今天的对话——或许在一个更特殊，更神圣，...
say:6:1110626004:0.male: We must have a proper catch-up in a more appropriate... private, place.
say:6:1110626004:0.female: We must have a proper catch-up in a more appropriate... private, place.

say:8:1110626005:0.text: Magister Merlin is... gone? On, um... urgent business! But not to worry, all is well!
say:8:1110626005:0.source_cn: 梅林大人……离开了！咳咳，虽然是紧急状况，但没有关系！
say:8:1110626005:0.male: Magister Merlin is... gone? On, um... urgent business! But not to worry, all is well!
say:8:1110626005:0.female: Magister Merlin is... gone? On, um... urgent business! But not to worry, all is well!

say:9:1110626006:0.text: Mikola knows just what we need! More fierce competition!
say:9:1110626006:0.source_cn: 曼卡拉有办法处理！我们紧急进行其他比赛——

say:10:1110626007:0.text: What a show <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Magister Merlin put on!
say:10:1110626007:0.male: What a show <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Magister Merlin put on!
say:10:1110626007:0.female: What a show <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Magister Merlin put on!

say:13:1110626009:1.text: That was no small feat. You actually defeated your teacher.
say:13:1110626009:1.source_cn: 真不简单。你居然能赢过你的老师。
say:13:1110626009:1.male: That was no small feat. You actually defeated your teacher.
say:13:1110626009:1.female: That was no small feat. You actually defeated your teacher.

say:15:1110626010:1.text: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?
say:15:1110626010:1.source_cn: ……主人，现在也是时候把真相告诉他们了吧！
say:15:1110626010:1.male: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?
say:15:1110626010:1.female: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?

choice_prompt:17:1110626010.text: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?
choice_prompt:17:1110626010.source_cn: ……主人，现在也是时候把真相告诉他们了吧！
choice_prompt:17:1110626010.male: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?
choice_prompt:17:1110626010.female: ...Magister, it's time to tell them the truth, no?

say:18:1110626011:1.text: Huh? So you've been looking for this imposter Merlin to expose him?
say:18:1110626011:1.source_cn: 诶？所以，你们一直想找梅林的原因，其实是想要揭穿这家伙...
say:18:1110626011:1.male: Huh? So you've been looking for this imposter Merlin to expose him?
say:18:1110626011:1.female: Huh? So you've been looking for this imposter Merlin to expose her?

say:19:1110626012:1.text: A phony? Well, that makes sense now...
say:19:1110626012:1.source_cn: 假货吗？不过，这样就说得通了。
say:19:1110626012:1.male: A phony? Well, that makes sense now...
say:19:1110626012:1.female: A phony? Well, that makes sense now...

say:20:1110626013:1.text: To travel all the way to the desert to defend Merlin's honor—
say:20:1110626013:1.source_cn: 为了捍卫梅林的名誉，经历千难万险来到沙漠——
say:20:1110626013:1.male: To travel all the way to the desert to defend Merlin's honor—
say:20:1110626013:1.female: To travel all the way to the desert to defend Merlin's honor—

say:21:1110626014:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?
say:21:1110626014:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?
say:21:1110626014:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?

choice_prompt:22:1110626014.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?
choice_prompt:22:1110626014.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，对你来说，梅林一定是很重要的人吧？
choice_prompt:22:1110626014.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?
choice_prompt:22:1110626014.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Merlin must mean a lot to you, huh?

say:23:1110626015:1.text: Understandable. If Soren and I were in your shoes and someone was impersonating Pops, we'd never let it slide!
say:23:1110626015:1.source_cn: 能理解，毕竟如果换成我和索恩，要是听到有人冒充老爹、诋...
say:23:1110626015:1.male: Understandable. If Soren and I were in your shoes and someone was impersonating Pops, we'd never let it slide!
say:23:1110626015:1.female: Understandable. If Soren and I were in your shoes and someone was impersonating Pops, we'd never let it slide!

say:24:1110626016:1.text: Not to mention the fact that Pops always said Magister Merlin is like a hero to us!
say:24:1110626016:1.source_cn: 更别说，老爹一直耳提面命——梅林大人是我们的恩人！
say:24:1110626016:1.male: Not to mention the fact that Pops always said Magister Merlin is like a hero to us!
say:24:1110626016:1.female: Not to mention the fact that Pops always said Magister Merlin is like a hero to us!

say:25:1110626017:1.text: Our feelings for Pops might not exactly mirror yours for Merlin, but Alsa and I have never had any other admirable adults in our lives.
say:25:1110626017:1.source_cn: 我们对老爹的感情，和你对梅林的感情或许不同。但我和阿尔...
say:25:1110626017:1.male: Our feelings for Pops might not exactly mirror yours for Merlin, but Alsa and I have never had any other admirable adults in our lives.
say:25:1110626017:1.female: Our feelings for Pops might not exactly mirror yours for Merlin, but Alsa and I have never had any other admirable adults in our lives.

say:26:1110626018:1.text: You're bound to uphold your teacher's honor, as we are to fulfilling our promise to Pops.
say:26:1110626018:1.source_cn: 你一定能捍卫你老师的荣耀。就像我们一定会实现对老爹的诺...
say:26:1110626018:1.male: You're bound to uphold your teacher's honor, as we are to fulfilling our promise to Pops.
say:26:1110626018:1.female: You're bound to uphold your teacher's honor, as we are to fulfilling our promise to Pops.

say:27:1110626019:1.text: We'll leave all our opponents in the dust, and stand by you as you seek justice!
say:27:1110626019:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们会战胜后面的对手，陪你一起，为梅林讨回公道！
say:27:1110626019:1.male: We'll leave all our opponents in the dust, and stand by you as you seek justice!
say:27:1110626019:1.female: We'll leave all our opponents in the dust, and stand by you as you seek justice!

choice:4:1:2.text: That's all you want to say?
choice:4:1:2.male: That's all you want to say?
choice:4:1:2.female: That's all you want to say?

narration:0:1110627001:0.text: A few days later, the preliminary rounds of the Warsong Festival end...
narration:0:1110627001:0.source_cn: 几日后，战歌节初赛结束……

say:1:1110628001:1.text: Honored friends of Mikola! The preliminary rounds of the Warsong Festival have concluded!
say:1:1110628001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们！战歌节初赛的赛程，到此结束！

say:2:1110628002:1.text: Advancing ahead will be the Uru Clan and the Grimmaw Clan! That includes the likes of Orson and Brutus!
say:2:1110628002:1.source_cn: 晋级两个氏族分别是乌尔氏族和黑嚎氏族！包括战神布鲁特斯...

say:3:1110628003:1.text: Who among them will bathe in supreme glory atop the Mars Peak? We'll see you at the summit!
say:3:1110628003:1.source_cn: 究竟是谁能沐浴残阳神至高的荣耀？让我们战神峰顶见！

say:0:1110629001:0.text: It's like a dream... Soren, pinch me!
say:0:1110629001:0.source_cn: 真像做梦一样啊……索恩，你掐我一下！

say:1:1110629002:0.text: Let's hurry. Otherwise, we'll get barred for being late—
say:1:1110629002:0.source_cn: 不要，快走了。不然因为赶不上决战而失败——

say:2:1110629003:0.text: Don't say that! Pops would haunt my dreams forever! Let's go!
say:2:1110629003:0.source_cn: 啊啊！别说了，要是出了这种事，梦里的老爹一定会罚我的！...

say:4:1110630005:0.text: As expected, the members of the Uru Clan.
say:4:1110630005:0.source_cn: 意料之中，乌尔氏族的诸位

say:1:1110631001:1.text: It's an honor to meet the finalists of the Warsong Festival.
say:1:1110631001:1.source_cn: 能见到本届战歌节挺进决赛的勇士们，是我们的荣幸。

say:2:1110631002:1.text: At this moment, you are undoubtedly among the strongest in the desert.
say:2:1110631002:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，你们无疑是这片沙漠上的最强者。

say:3:1110631003:1.text: Please allow me to confirm your identity before you head to <style="highlight">Mars Peak</style>.
say:3:1110631003:1.source_cn: 请容我在查验诸位身份后，放行诸位通往<style=hi...

say:6:1110631005:1.text: Let me see... Brutus, Kruger, Alsa, and Soren—all are in attendance.
say:6:1110631005:1.source_cn: 让我看看——布鲁特斯大人，克鲁格大人，阿尔萨大人，索恩...

say:7:1110631006:1.text: And Orson? Has he not traveled with you all?
say:7:1110631006:1.source_cn: 还有，奥格大人？他没有和诸位一起行动吗？

choice_prompt:9:1110631006.text: And Orson? Has he not traveled with you all?
choice_prompt:9:1110631006.source_cn: 还有，奥格大人？他没有和诸位一起行动吗？

say:10:1110631007:1.text: As I recall, he was quite injured from the last match. Kruger, do you know where he is?
say:10:1110631007:1.source_cn: 我记得那场比赛中他并没有受重伤。克鲁格，你知道奥格现在...

say:12:1110631008:1.text: Sorry, no. I'm a bit worried about him... he's been keeping to himself lately.
say:12:1110631008:1.source_cn: 抱歉。我也很担心奥格，但他最近有些独来独往。我也没怎么...

say:14:1110631009:1.text: Strange... A Mauler would never shy away from the Warsong Festival.
say:14:1110631009:1.source_cn: 唔……真奇怪，没有蛮血会愿意放弃战歌节的荣耀，奥格那样...

say:15:1110631010:1.text: Time is of the essence, so you all go on ahead. After all, the ascent demands great strength and stamina.
say:15:1110631010:1.source_cn: 时间有限，你们先出发吧。毕竟登顶本身也需要足够的时间和体力。

say:16:1110631011:1.text: I'll wait here and make the climb with him!
say:16:1110631011:1.source_cn: 我等在这里，跟他一起上去！

say:18:1110631012:1.text: Let's go, we can't let this throw us off...
say:18:1110631012:1.source_cn: 走吧，别被那家伙影响我们的比赛……

choice:9:1:2.text: He doesn't seem to be here...
choice:9:1:2.male: He doesn't seem to be here...
choice:9:1:2.female: He doesn't seem to be here...

say:0:1110632001:0.text: Kruger, don't worry! Orson should be here soon.
say:0:1110632001:0.source_cn: 克鲁格大人，别担心！奥格应该会赶过来的……

say:1:1110632002:0.text: Thank you for your kind words, Alsa.

say:0:1110633001:0.text: Kruger... I really don't mean to pry, but...
say:0:1110633001:0.source_cn: 那个，克鲁格大人……我发誓我没刻意去打听！

say:1:1110633002:0.text: I heard many of the Grimmaw Clan now support you over Orson.
say:1:1110633002:0.source_cn: 但听说那场比赛之后，不少黑嚎族人从支持奥格转向支持您了。

say:2:1110633003:0.text: I've heard the same, but I believe mere rumors cannot shake the ties of blood.
say:2:1110633003:0.source_cn: ……我不否认这样的流言存在，但它们不会动摇血亲之间的信任。

say:0:1110634001:0.text: Orson's fighting style is different than how I remember...
say:0:1110634001:0.source_cn: 奥格……他战斗的方式和我记忆中不同了。

say:1:1110634002:0.text: Hmm... Orson hasn't let go of his past defeat.
say:1:1110634002:0.source_cn: 嗯……奥格他对当年的失败，并没有释怀。

say:2:1110634003:0.text: He remains a worthy opponent, though we don't see eye to eye.
say:2:1110634003:0.source_cn: 但他依然是一个可敬的对手，尽管我对他的行事并不能苟同……

say:0:1110635001:0.text: It seems something out of the ordinary is hindering Orson.
say:0:1110635001:0.source_cn: 看来，奥格似乎被非同寻常的事情绊住了脚步……

say:1:1110635002:0.text: Let's press on. Orson won't waste a chance for glory and battle.
say:1:1110635002:0.source_cn: ……我们先过去吧，我相信他，不会放弃战斗的机会和荣耀。

say:0:1110637001:0.text: Your wounds are severe. Let me heal you.
say:0:1110637001:0.source_cn: 你的伤势有些严重，让我来处理下。
say:0:1110637001:0.male: Your wounds are severe. Let me heal you.
say:0:1110637001:0.female: Your wounds are severe. Let me heal you.

say:0:1110638001:0.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I feel much better.
say:0:1110638001:0.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I feel much better.
say:0:1110638001:0.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I feel much better.

say:1:1110639001:1.text: Brutus, by my honor I'm utterly ashamed of what Orson has done. Are you truly alright?
say:1:1110639001:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，我为奥格的作为感到惭愧。您真的还好吗？

say:2:1110639002:0.text: Please let me escort you down the mountain. As a representative of the Grimmaw Clan, it's my duty to remedy his wrongdoing.
say:2:1110639002:0.source_cn: 请先让我送您下山，处理伤情。奥格的过错，我作为黑嚎氏族...

say:4:1110639003:1.text: Kruger, I appreciate your words, but I'm not leaving.
say:4:1110639003:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，我理解你的心情。但我不会走的。

say:6:1110639005:1.text: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.
say:6:1110639005:1.source_cn: 稍安勿躁。刚才，乌尔氏族的魔法师朋友替我处理了伤口。现...
say:6:1110639005:1.male: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.
say:6:1110639005:1.female: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.

say:7:1110639006:1.text: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.
say:7:1110639006:1.source_cn: 多谢你，朋友。托你的福，我现在已经准备好迎接下一次战斗。
say:7:1110639006:1.male: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.
say:7:1110639006:1.female: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.

say:9:1110639008:1.text: Kruger, this wasn't your doing. Blaming yourself isn't heroic; you don't have to bear any guilt in the name of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:9:1110639008:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，这不是你的错。迁怒并非英雄所为，你不必为了保护...

say:10:1110639009:1.text: Moreover, my concern is for the young Alsa and Soren. Of course, Orson also troubles me. I wonder who did this to him...
say:10:1110639009:1.source_cn: 而且，我很担心索恩和阿尔萨这两个年轻人。当然，我也像你...

say:11:1110639010:1.source_cn: 我明白了，既然话说到这个地步，我没有理由再反对。

say:12:1110639011:1.text: Let's make for the summit. There's no telling what awaits us there, but we must be prepared.
say:12:1110639011:1.source_cn: 登上峰顶吧。那里或许正在发生我们不愿看到的事……但我们...

say:1:1110649001:1.text: A moving display of brotherly love, however excruciatingly cliché it might have been.
say:1:1110649001:1.source_cn: 真是感人至深的兄弟情，俗套——

say:2:1110649002:1.text: Just as cliché as the ending of the Warsong Festival.
say:2:1110649002:1.source_cn: 俗套的，好像战歌节的结局。

say:3:1110649003:1.text: And look at you, Magister Merlin, stuffing secrets up your sleeves. So mysterious...
say:3:1110649003:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，你的身上似乎隐藏了更深的秘密，真是有趣……
say:3:1110649003:1.male: And look at you, Magister Merlin, stuffing secrets up your sleeves. So mysterious...
say:3:1110649003:1.female: And look at you, Magister Merlin, stuffing secrets up your sleeves. So mysterious...

say:4:1110649004:1.text: Alas, it's time dear Berial took a bow—the show is over... for now. Next time I'll have an even more spectacular performance to share with you all... Toodle-oo!
say:4:1110649004:1.source_cn: 那么，贝利尔就此退场……哦，只是本场演出。下次，我会带...
say:4:1110649004:1.male: Alas, it's time dear Berial took a bow—the show is over... for now. Next time I'll have an even more spectacular performance to share with you all... Toodle-oo!
say:4:1110649004:1.female: Alas, it's time dear Berial took a bow—the show is over... for now. Next time I'll have an even more spectacular performance to share with you all... Toodle-oo!

say:6:1110649005:1.text: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?
say:6:1110649005:1.male: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?
say:6:1110649005:1.female: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?

choice_prompt:7:1110649005.text: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?
choice_prompt:7:1110649005.source_cn: 刚刚一直忘了问，<style=stress><player_name></style>……你才是真正的梅林？
choice_prompt:7:1110649005.male: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?
choice_prompt:7:1110649005.female: I suppose it must be asked... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are you actually the real Merlin?

say:9:1110649006:1.text: I should've known... You're not exactly the most typical mage to visit the desert.
say:9:1110649006:1.source_cn: 我早该猜到的……并不是每个来自沙漠外的魔法师都和你一样。
say:9:1110649006:1.male: I should've known... You're not exactly the most typical mage to visit the desert.
say:9:1110649006:1.female: I should've known... You're not exactly the most typical mage to visit the desert.

say:10:1110649007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the real Merlin! The savior of the Uru Clan!
say:10:1110649007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the real Merlin! The savior of the Uru Clan!
say:10:1110649007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the real Merlin! The savior of the Uru Clan!

say:12:1110649008:1.text: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?
say:12:1110649008:1.male: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?
say:12:1110649008:1.female: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?

choice_prompt:13:1110649008.text: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?
choice_prompt:13:1110649008.source_cn: 原来<style=stress><player_name></style>才是真正的梅林吗？那么刚刚消失的是……
choice_prompt:13:1110649008.male: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?
choice_prompt:13:1110649008.female: ... But if <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the real Merlin, who—or what, was that?

say:16:1110649010:1.text: Hypogeans have returned to this world? While I haven't faced them personally, history and legends are riddled with warnings. This warrants discussion with all the clans...
say:16:1110649010:1.source_cn: 恶魔……再度现世了吗？虽然我未曾经历与恶魔对抗的时光，...
say:16:1110649010:1.male: Hypogeans have returned to this world? While I haven't faced them personally, history and legends are riddled with warnings. This warrants discussion with all the clans...
say:16:1110649010:1.female: Hypogeans have returned to this world? While I haven't faced them personally, history and legends are riddled with warnings. This warrants discussion with all the clans...

say:18:1110649011:1.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, but it's time I take my leave. I need to bring Orson home...
say:18:1110649011:1.source_cn: 抱歉，打断一下诸位。我想，我们应该告辞了。我得带着奥格...

say:19:1110649012:1.text: Brutus, please tell Mikola that... the Grimmaw Clan is withdrawing from the Warsong Festival.
say:19:1110649012:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，请转告曼卡拉……黑嚎氏族要退出战歌节比赛了。

say:20:1110649013:1.text: I will do as you ask. Kruger, you have my condolences.
say:20:1110649013:1.source_cn: 我会转达的。克鲁格，节哀……

choice_prompt:22:1110649013.text: I will do as you ask. Kruger, you have my condolences.
choice_prompt:22:1110649013.source_cn: 我会转达的。克鲁格，节哀……

say:23:1110649014:1.source_cn: 奥格，虽然轻信了他人，但他最后是受人操控……

say:24:1110649015:1.text: Needless to say, Orson will always be hailed a hero of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:24:1110649015:1.source_cn: 索恩，不必说了。无论如何，奥格，仍会是黑嚎的英雄。

say:25:1110649016:1.text: If you'll allow it, I'd like to visit you in the coming days.
say:25:1110649016:1.source_cn: 如果不会引起你们的反感，我希望能在近日前去拜访……

say:26:1110649017:1.text: In time, Brutus. First, we must leave this place.
say:26:1110649017:1.source_cn: 再等等吧，布鲁特斯大人。我们先走一步……

say:29:1110649019:1.text: Soren, do you remember when I asked you about your initial intentions for participating in the Warsong Festival?
say:29:1110649019:1.source_cn: 索恩，在魂之试炼结束时，我曾问过你参加战歌节的初心。你...

say:30:1110649020:1.text: I remember, Brutus. I said I wanted to become stronger, so that I may defend the ones I care about.
say:30:1110649020:1.source_cn: 我记得，布鲁特斯大人。我想变强，想要保护其他的人……

say:31:1110649021:1.text: Seeking strength is indeed a worthy pursuit, but blindly chasing power may distort intentions, however pure they may be. Soren, reflect on what you've learned.
say:31:1110649021:1.source_cn: 变强固然是件好事，但一味地追逐强大，或许会扭曲自己的初...

say:32:1110649022:1.text: I will consider this carefully. Thank you for your guidance.
say:32:1110649022:1.source_cn: 我……会思考这件事的，谢谢您的教导。

say:33:1110649023:1.text: Everyone, it seems there's no need for more competition in the Warsong Festival. Let's inform Mikola of all that's occurred.
say:33:1110649023:1.source_cn: 诸位，看样子战歌节的比赛也无需进行了。我们离开这里吧，...

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 不好意思，之前骗了你们

subtitle:1:1110621001:.text: This is truly a pitiful sight.
subtitle:1:1110621001:.male: This is truly a pitiful sight.
subtitle:1:1110621001:.female: This is truly a pitiful sight.

subtitle:1:1110621002:.text: I guess I'll take it from here.
subtitle:1:1110621002:.source_cn: 算了，之后还是我亲自处理吧。
subtitle:1:1110621002:.male: I guess I'll take it from here.
subtitle:1:1110621002:.female: I guess I'll take it from here.

subtitle:1:1110621004:.text: I'm really looking forward to when we meet...
subtitle:1:1110621004:.male: I'm really looking forward to when we meet...
subtitle:1:1110621004:.female: I'm really looking forward to when we meet...

subtitle:1:1110636001:.text: Orson, this isn't the time for games.
subtitle:1:1110636001:.source_cn: 奥格，现在还不到比赛的时候。

subtitle:1:1110636003:.source_cn: 奥格，我的兄弟，你在做什么？

subtitle:1:1110644005:.text: The proof of the setting sun
subtitle:1:1110644005:.male: The proof of the setting sun
subtitle:1:1110644005:.female: The proof of the setting sun

subtitle:1:1110644012:.text: The Mark of the Setting Sun!

subtitle:1:1110644013:.text: I don't like this one bit!
subtitle:1:1110644013:.source_cn: 我一点都不喜欢这个结局！

subtitle:1:1110644015:.text: Let me inject a bit of excitement into the grand finale!
subtitle:1:1110644015:.source_cn: 让我来给结局加一点点惊喜！
